title: Distributionally Faithful Imputation via Positive Semi-Definite Kernel Density Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2607.07767v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Missing values undermine statistical inference and machine learning pipelines, yet most imputation methods rely on heuristics or restrictive parametric assumptions that ignore the joint data distribution. We recast imputation under missing completely at random (MCAR) as density estimation from masked observations: estimate a distribution whose observed marginals exactly match those in the data. Leveraging positive semidefinite (PSD) kernel densities we obtain a convex empirical risk problem with closed form marginals, solvable by a Newton interior point method. We further introduce a non convex extension that supports adaptive hyperparameter selection through alternating minimization. The resulting PSD-Impute model yields both single and multiple imputations from the same fitted density, enjoys statistical consistency, beating the curse of dimensionality for very regular probabilities. translated_title: 通过半正定核密度估计实现分布忠实的缺失值插补
translated_abstract: 缺失值会损害统计推断和机器学习流程，然而大多数插补方法依赖于启发式方法或限制性的参数假设，忽略了数据的联合分布。我们将完全随机缺失（MCAR）下的插补问题重新表述为基于掩码观测的密度估计问题：估计一个分布，使其观测到的边缘分布与数据中的边缘分布完全吻合。利用半正定（PSD）核密度，我们得到了一个具有闭式边缘解的凸经验风险问题，可通过牛顿内点法求解。我们进一步引入了一个非凸扩展，通过交替最小化实现自适应超参数选择。由此产生的 PSD-Impute 模型能够从同一拟合密度中生成单次插补和多重插补，并具有统计一致性，对于非常规则的概率分布能够克服维度灾难。实验表明该模型在分布拟合方面具有竞争力。
tldr: 该论文提出 PSD-Impute 模型，将 MCAR 缺失值插补重新表述为基于半正定核密度的密度估计问题，构建了具有闭式边缘解的凸优化问题并具备统计一致性，可同时实现单次与多重插补。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PSD-Impute, which recasts MCAR imputation as density estimation with positive semi-definite kernel densities, yielding a convex problem with closed-form marginals, statistical consistency, and unified support for both single and multiple imputations.
